products.body_html:
Synty Studios™ presents:  POLYGON - Woodland Apocalypse Map Bundle
___________________________________ 

Complete your apocalypse game with this high value, three-pack bundle containing POLYGON Apocalypse Pack, POLYGON Alpine Mountain Nature Biome and POLYGON Woodland Apocalypse Map. 

This bundle gives you an incredible 30% off all three!

Synty map packs are designed to help inspire you with level design, and save you time with pre-dressed areas ready to place into your project. You'll be able to bring your apocalypse game or project to life quickly and easily. 

This bundle includes:

POLYGON - Apocalypse Pack

Our biggest Apocalypse themed pack to date. Filled with more apocalypse assets than you could shake a plague, nuclear or zombie apocalypse at. Includes modular bunker systems, modular quarantine walls and buildings with detailed interiors. The icing on the cake? A complete modular gun system - create thousands of custom guns!

POLYGON  - Alpine Mountain Nature Biome

Explore this canvas of vibrant hues, from the rich greens of pine trees to the fiery reds, all harmoniously set against the backdrop of snow-capped summits. Alpine Mountain captures the essence of every season, from deep autumn hues, to frosty snow covered trees. Perfect for more than just an apocalypse.

POLYGON - Woodland Apocalypse Map

Unravel the tragic story of Hope's End. This roadside town served as the perfect rest spot before the zombie apocalypse. Abandoned quarantine tents sit torn and broken, survivors wait their fate behind makeshift defences in the local hotel. This map strikes the balance between the horrors of the apocalypse, encased in the beauty of alpine woodlands, lakes and forest.

products.title: POLYGON - Fantasy Village
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Fantasy Village

Take a stroll through the charming, cozy hamlet with a vibrant town center, explore the vast farmland and cottages, and meet some new furry familiars.

In this village you’ll find bountiful streams filled with fish, cozy cottages, lush hills dotted with farms and windmills. The vibrant, idyllic landscape is home to plant, insect, and animal life.

The vibrant town centre is brimming with bustling stalls, gorgeous gardens, and an ale filled tavern. Step outside the square to find farmland overflowing with crops providing plenty of food for the townsfolk. 

Explore the outer edges of the village to find water filled ruins filled with fountains, waterfalls and lilypads. Adventure towards the mysterious giant sword which hints at an age long past. This pack has everything you need to bring your dream adventure, RPG, or simulation game to life!

  • 1,000+ unique prefabs / models

products.title: INTERFACE - Modern Menus
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE - Modern Menus

This UI pack contains sprites and components like menu screens, frames, buttons, popups and icons, which allow you to make grounded, realistic games where you can drive a car off a skyscraper or perform a 1440 heelflip while rail grinding the length of the Golden Gate Bridge. 

Modern Menus is intended to work seamlessly alongside Synty’s POLYGON assets, and blend with our library of themed INTERFACE packs. Perfect for a wide variety of modern style games including simulation, heist, sports, management, and more!

Key Features:

  • 120+ icons with angled and flat variants, meshes included
  • 350+ prefabs (with animations!)
  • 1,000+ sprites and icons
  • Customisable visual variants for components allow you to add your own style to your game’s menus. Create hundreds of variations to fit your game’s specific needs!
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam Deck.
  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of POLYGON assets.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised and localised. 

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with Unity’s UGUI and 2D systems. The sprites can be used in any UI program. 3D models are included for the icon set. 

◼ Complete Your Project ◼

Modern Menus is designed to complement Synty's library of modern world themed packs including those used to create the promotional images for this pack: POLYGON Palm City, POLYGON Pro Racer, POLYGON Police Station, POLYGON Town and Sidekick Modern Civilians.

◼ Interface Tutorials ◼

New to exploring UI? Head to the official Synty YouTube channel for INTERFACE tutorials.

🔍 FAQs

Q: Can I use the fonts in this pack for my game or project?
A: Yes, the fonts included in this pack are Google Fonts -  Barlow Condensed, Bungee and Saira Condensed. You will be able to find more information in the pack documentation, and can check out the Google Fonts FAQ here. 

See the bottom of this page for more INTERFACE related FAQs.

products.title: POLYGON - Military Warehouse Map
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Military Warehouse Map

This pack requires: POLYGON - Military Pack

This map pack is an expansion add-on for POLYGON Military Pack, featuring a new demo scene and a few new assets created just for this map pack. Synty map packs are designed to help inspire you with level design, and save you time with pre-dressed areas ready to place into your project!

In this military shooter map pack you will find a new close-quarters death-match style level demo scene, including multiple warehouses, vehicle garage, an oil tower and more. You’ll also get brand new props including modular warehouse pieces, shipping crates, office items, and defensive barriers, and new decals including directional arrows, objective markers, damage cracks, and player sprays.

Key Features:

  • New buildings ready to place into your project with ease!
  • Level map designed for shooters / FPS gameplay 
  • 42 new prefabs / models
  • 17 new military and spray decals
  • Generic assets folder with 350+ prefabs/models including buildings, props, environment, weapons, and FX

*Contents may vary between engines

📦 Pack Content

Assets

Props
42 props including modular warehouse pieces, shipping crates, office props, and defensive barriers.    

Decals
17 decals including directional arrows, objective markers, damage cracks, and player sprays.

Map Areas
Military warehouse, vehicle garage, underground carpark, oil tower, loot warehouse, container bay, and a satellite station.

🤖 Technical Info

This pack requires: POLYGON - Military Pack

◼ Compatibility ◼

  • Compatible with Unreal 5.3+
  • Compatible with Unity 2022.3+
    - Supports URP and Built-in
    - Characters set up with Mecanim (no animations included)

◼ File Formats ◼

  • Unreal 5.3 project
  • Unity 2022.3 package
  • FBX Source Files

products.title: Modern Police - Sidekick Modular Characters
products.body_html:
Synty Studios presents: Modern Police – Sidekick Modular Characters

This Sidekick content pack puts a variety of uniformed officers into your character creation tool kit. Fill your modern game world with badges, vests, and hats utilising 70+ new parts including clothing, hair styles, accessories and 90+ human species base parts.

With this pack, you can create a wide variety of customised law enforcement characters designed to suit your project! Unleash your creativity or utilise our expert presets. 

Build and customise characters in the editor with the feature-rich Sidekick Character Creator tool designed for Unity and included with this Sidekick content pack! Using the tool you can combine multiple Sidekick packs to create endless, unique character combinations that bridge genres.

Create immersive character customisation experiences with the Sidekick Runtime API. Whether you're building a full in-game character creator, or just changing outfits on the fly, the Sidekick Runtime API makes it easy. 

Pack Content Features:

  • 70+ modular, rigged Modern Police parts (clothing, hair and more)
  • 90+ modular, rigged human base species parts (torsos, legs, hands, feet etc.)
  • Fully rigged to the Unity Humanoid skeleton (Mecanim compatible)
  • Dynamic joints allow you to add realistic motion to capes, hair, beards etc.
  • Facial blend shapes for expressions and lipsync (works with ARKit)
  • Body blend shapes to adjust body type and proportions
  • Designed to cohesively match Synty POLYGON environments
  • Designed to work seamlessly with Synty ANIMATION packs

Sidekick Character Creator Tool (Editor Extension) Features:

  • Customise material colours directly in the editor
  • Expert presets to enable rapid character creation
  • Save and load custom characters for future editing
  • Bake completed characters into a single optimised prefab, combining all skinned mesh renderers into one for performance friendly deployment
  • Runtime API for in-game character customisation
  • Mix and match Sidekick themes to create endless, unique characters
📦 Pack Content
  • 77 Modern Police parts
  • 91 Sidekick human species base parts
  • Access to the Sidekick Character Creator Tool

Modular Part Types

products.title: POLYGON - Palm City
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Palm City

Welcome to Palm City! A lively, coastal city with a beach, vibrant city centre, art deco inspired main street and more.

On the busy beachfront you’ll find a skate park, a bustling boardwalk, a variety of shops, an outdoor workout area, and a pier – all teeming with activity. 

The vibrant city centre is complete with high rises, a parking building, and a monumental art deco tower. Step out onto the main avenue lined with an array of art deco shops and apartments before taking a spin on the iconic ferris wheel.

products.title: INTERFACE - Sci-Fi Menus
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE - Sci-Fi Menus

Found within a glowing mid-poly pyramid in orbit around a dying star, our intrepid space explorers discovered alien artifacts such as menu screens, frames, buttons, popups and icons, as well as sprites made of unknown alloys which can be assembled into sci-fi crests.

This pack contains dozens of pre-built menu screens and pop-ups that can be easily customized to suit the needs of your project. It is intended to work alongside Synty’s library of INTERFACE packs including Sci-Fi Soldier HUD.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • Over 200 prefabs (with animations!)
  • 850+ sprites and icons
  • Customisable visual variants for components allow you to add your own style to your game’s menus. Create hundreds of variations to fit your game’s specific needs!
  • Customisable crest components and sprites for creating game title lockups and menu panel imagery.
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck.
  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of sci-fi and space assets.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised and localised. 

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with Unity’s UGUI and 2D systems. The sprites can be used in any UI program. No 3D models are included. 

◼ Complete Your Project ◼

Sci-Fi Menus is designed to complement Synty's library of sci-fi and space themed packs including INTERFACE Sci-Fi Soldier HUD, POLYGON Sci-Fi Worlds, and Sidekick Modular Characters - Sci-Fi Soldiers.

products.body_html:
Synty Studios presents: Fantasy Villagers – Sidekick Modular Characters

This Sidekick content pack puts a variety of villagers into your character creation kingdom. Fill your fantasy game world with villagers, townspeople, and NPCs utilising 80+ new parts including clothing, hair styles, accessories and 90+ human species base parts.

With this pack, you can create a wide variety of customised fantasy and medieval characters designed to suit your project! Unleash your creativity or utilise our expert presets. 

Build and customise characters in the editor with the feature-rich Sidekick Character Creator tool designed for Unity and included with this Sidekick content pack! Using the tool you can combine multiple Sidekick packs to create endless, unique character combinations that bridge genres.

Create immersive character customisation experiences with the Sidekick Runtime API. Whether you're building a full in-game character creator, or just changing outfits on the fly, the Sidekick Runtime API makes it easy. 

Pack Content Features:

  • 80+ modular, rigged Fantasy Villager parts (clothing, hair and more)
  • 90+ modular, rigged human base species parts (torsos, legs, hands, feet etc.)
  • Fully rigged to the Unity Humanoid skeleton (Mecanim compatible)
  • Dynamic joints allow you to add realistic motion to capes, hair, beards etc.
  • Facial blend shapes for expressions and lipsync (works with ARKit)
  • Body blend shapes to adjust body type and proportions
  • Designed to cohesively match Synty POLYGON environments
  • Designed to work seamlessly with Synty ANIMATION packs

Sidekick Character Creator Tool (Editor Extension) Features:

  • Customise material colours directly in the editor
  • Expert presets to enable rapid character creation
  • Save and load custom characters for future editing
  • Bake completed characters into a single optimised prefab, combining all skinned mesh renderers into one for performance friendly deployment
  • Runtime API for in-game character customisation
  • Mix and match Sidekick themes to create endless, unique characters

products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: ANIMATION - Emotes and Taunts

Your characters will be able to salute, fist bump, and flex with ease! This pack comes complete with 140 essential emote and taunt animations to help bring your project to life.

These meticulously hand-crafted animations will accelerate your workflow, providing a cohesive collection of motions designed to integrate seamlessly with Synty’s POLYGON and Sidekick characters, and library of ANIMATION packs. 

Check out a video showcase of animations in this pack on YouTube!

◼ Key Features ◼

Animation Sets
140 animation FBX files, including RootMotion, POLYGON/Sidekick, and masculine/feminine versions. Each animation is a separate file, allowing you to import only the animations you need into your project. 

Gallery Scene
We’ve included a scene featuring all the animations as a separate asset, so you can view each individual animation and find what you need easily.

Works with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion and Unity’s Mecanim
This pack includes documentation to guide you on how to blend Emotes and Taunts with Synty’s Base Locomotion animations.

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

*Please note the Sidekick characters shown in the marketing images are not included with this pack. Pack includes 1x POLYGON crash test dummy, 2x base human Sidekick characters (male and female).

❓ FAQs

Q: Does this pack work with Unity’s Mecanim Animation System?
A: Yes! However, this pack only supports Sidekicks, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters.

Q: Can I use this pack with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion?
A: Yes, documentation is provided to guide you in blending this pack with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion. There's an example animation controller included in the Base Locomotion pack, as well as transition animations in this pack to help with integration.

Q: Do these animations work with Synty Sidekick and POLYGON characters?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with Sidekick characters, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: No, these animations do not work with SIMPLE characters.

Q: Can I use the animations on my own custom rig?
A: Only POLYGON and Sidekick rigs, and retargeting using Mecanim, are officially supported. 

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal Engine?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

products.title: Apocalypse Zombies - Sidekick Modular Characters
products.body_html:
Synty Studios presents: Apocalypse Zombies – Sidekick Modular Characters

This Sidekick content pack puts a horde of decaying Apocalypse Zombies into your character creation vault. Open the crypt and release brain-dead zombies in to your post-apocalyptic or horror game world with 40+ new parts including helmets, weapons, backpacks, apocalyptic accessories and 120+ zombie species base parts.

With this pack, you can create a wide variety of customised apocalyptic zombie characters designed to suit your project! Unleash your creativity or utilise our expert presets. 

Build and customise characters in the editor with the feature-rich Sidekick Character Creator tool designed for Unity and included with this Sidekick content pack! Using the tool you can combine multiple Sidekick packs to create endless, unique character combinations that bridge genres.

Create immersive character customisation experiences with the Sidekick Runtime API. Whether you're building a full in-game character creator, or just changing outfits on the fly, the Sidekick Runtime API makes it easy. 

Pack Content Features:

  • 40+ modular, rigged Apocalypse Zombie parts (helmets, gear and more)
  • 120+ modular, rigged zombie base species parts (torsos, legs, hands, feet etc.)
  • Fully rigged to the Unity Humanoid skeleton (Mecanim compatible)
  • Dynamic joints allow you to add realistic motion to capes, hair, beards etc.
  • Facial blend shapes for expressions and lipsync (works with ARKit)
  • Body blend shapes to adjust body type and proportions
  • Designed to cohesively match Synty POLYGON environments
  • Designed to work seamlessly with Synty ANIMATION packs

Sidekick Character Creator Tool (Editor Extension) Features:

  • Customise material colours directly in the editor
  • Expert presets to enable rapid character creation
  • Save and load custom characters for future editing
  • Bake completed characters into a single optimised prefab, combining all skinned mesh renderers into one for performance friendly deployment
  • Runtime API for in-game character customisation
  • Mix and match Sidekick themes to create endless, unique characters
📦 Pack Content
  • 42 Apocalypse Zombie parts
  • 124 Sidekick zombie species base parts
  • Sidekick Character Creator Tool

Modular Part Types

  • Head and Face - head, hair, facial hair, eyebrows, eyes, ears, nose, teeth, tongue
  • Torso and limbs - torso, upper arms, lower arms, hands, hips, legs, feet
  • Attachments - head attachments, face attachments, back attachments, shoulder attachments, elbow attachments, knee attachments, hip attachments (front, back, left, right), wraps

Body Blend Shapes

  • Masculine/feminine, skinny/heavy, muscular

Facial Blend Shapes

  • Eyebrows (left/right) - frown, raise, inner down, inner up, outer down, outer up
  • Eyes (left/right) - up, down, left, right, blink, squint, wide
  • Nose - sneer left, sneer right
  • Cheeks (left/right) - hollow, puff
  • Jaw - close, open, left, right, backward, forward
  • Mouth - left, right, funnel, pucker, shrug upper, shrug lower, roll upper, roll out upper, roll lower, roll out lower, close, frown (left/right), smile (left/right), press (left/right), stretch (left/right), upper up (left/right), lower down (left/right)
  • Tongue - up, down, in, out, lower, raise, twist (left/right), curl up, curl down, curl left, curl right, side curl down, side curl up

Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Samurai Empire

Everything you need to build out your world of ancient warriors with stylised characters, buildings, props, and environments designed to bring your project to life quickly! 

In this pack you’ll find hundreds of assets to help you create mist-veiled valleys, gardens where cherry blossoms sway on the wind, bustling busy market streets, vibrant villages nestled in the rice terraces, shadow-cloaked assassins' keeps and more.

❓FAQ

Q: Does this pack work with Unity’s Mecanim Animation System?
A: Yes! However, this pack only supports Sidekicks, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters. ANIMATION - Bow Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other characters.

Q: Can I use this pack with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion?
A: Yes, documentation is provided to guide you in blending ANIMATION - Bow Combat with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion. There's an example animation controller included in the Base Locomotion pack, and in this Bow Combat pack you will find transition animations for integration with Base Locomotion.

Q: Do these animations work with Synty Sidekick and POLYGON characters?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with Sidekick characters, standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: No, these animations do not work with SIMPLE characters.

Q: Can I use the animations on my own custom rig?
A: ANIMATION - Bow Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other character rigs even when using mecanim.

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal Engine?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

🤖 Technical Info

◼ Compatibility ◼

  • Compatible with Unity 2022.3+
    - Supports URP, Built-in and HDRP

◼ File Formats ◼

  • Unity 2022.3 package
  • Animation FBX Zip File

◼ Compatibility Warning◼
- Unreal Engine: Unreal is not supported. Until we announce an Unreal release there is no timeline on when or if Unreal support will arrive in the future.

products.title: Fantasy Knights – Sidekick Modular Characters
products.body_html:
Synty Studios presents: Fantasy Knights – Sidekick Modular Characters

This Sidekick content pack puts a cavalry of brave Fantasy Knights into your character creation armoury! Ride into battle with over 100 brand new parts including broadswords, elaborate helmets, crowns, armour and more, designed to deliver just the noble knights your project needs.

With this pack, you can create a wide variety of customised Fantasy Knight characters designed to suit your project! Unleash your creativity or utilise our expert presets. 

Build and customise characters in the editor with the feature-rich Sidekick Character Creator tool designed for Unity and included with this Sidekick content pack! Using the tool you can combine multiple Sidekick packs to create endless, unique character combinations that bridge genres.

Create immersive character customisation experiences with the Sidekick Runtime API. Whether you're building a full in-game character creator, or just changing outfits on the fly, the Sidekick Runtime API makes it easy. 

Pack Content Features:

  • 100+ modular, rigged Fantasy Knight Parts (armour, hair, gear and more)
  • 90+ modular, rigged human base species parts (torsos, legs, hands, feet etc.)
  • Fully rigged to the Unity Humanoid skeleton (Mecanim compatible)
  • Dynamic joints allow you to add realistic motion to capes, hair, beards etc.
  • Facial blend shapes for expressions and lipsync (works with ARKit)
  • Body blend shapes to adjust body type and proportions
  • Designed to cohesively match Synty POLYGON environments
  • Designed to work seamlessly with Synty ANIMATION packs

Sidekick Character Creator Tool (Editor Extension) Features:

  • Customise material colours directly in the editor
  • Expert presets to enable rapid character creation
  • Save and load custom characters for future editing
  • Bake completed characters into a single optimised prefab, combining all skinned mesh renderers into one for performance friendly deployment
  • Runtime API for in-game character customisation
  • Mix and match Sidekick themes to create endless, unique characters
📦 Pack Content
  • 119 Fantasy Knight parts
  • 90+ Sidekick human species base parts
  • Sidekick Character Creator Tool

Modular Part Types

  • Head and Face - head, hair, facial hair, eyebrows, eyes, ears, nose, teeth, tongue
  • Torso and limbs - torso, upper arms, lower arms, hands, hips, legs, feet
  • Attachments - head attachments, face attachments, back attachments, shoulder attachments, elbow attachments, knee attachments, hip attachments (front, back, left, right), wraps

Body Blend Shapes

  • Masculine/feminine, skinny/heavy, muscular

products.title: INTERFACE - Dark Fantasy HUD
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE - Dark Fantasy HUD

The Dark Portal has opened, spilling forth hordes of UI sprites and components! Welcome to the diabolical realm of Synty’s Interface Dark Fantasy HUD pack.

This pack includes components to allow you to build out in-game inventory panels and popups, action bars, health and magic flasks, compasses, mini-maps, weapon wheels, and skulls. Lots and lots of skulls.  

Each component is designed for maximum flexibility, whether you’re making a Soulslike, an Action RPG or a sprawling open world adventure.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 200+ prefabs (with animations!)

  • 1,400+ sprites and icons

  • Customisable visual variants for components allow you to add your own style to your game’s UI. Create hundreds of variations to fit your specific needs!

  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck.

  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of fantasy assets.

  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised and localised. 

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with Unity’s UGUI and 2D systems. The sprites can be used in any UI program. Only one 3D model is included (flask). 

◼ Complete Your Project ◼

Icons featuring props and weapons in this HUD pack are rendered from items and weapons found in POLYGON Dark Fantasy and POLYGON Dungeons, these packs, alongside our Sidekick characters like Knights and Skeletons, are the perfect match to Dark Fantasy HUD. You can see the pack mash-ups in full effect in the screenshots! 

◼ Interface Tutorials ◼

New to exploring UI? Head to the official Synty YouTube channel for INTERFACE tutorials.

🔍 FAQs

Q: Can I use the fonts in this pack for my game or project?
A: Yes, fonts included in this pack are Google Fonts called Pirata One and Markazi. You can find more information in the pack documentation or can check out the Google Fonts FAQ here.

products.title: POLYGON - Pro Racer
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Pro Racer

Start your engines! High octane action is around every corner with customisable, lightning fast cars across open wheel, stock, touring, rally and more.

Modular parts, openable doors, bonnets, hoods, trunks and 16 custom liveries give unique ways to personalise, and bring life to your courses and characters!

Build out your racing world with modular grandstand and tunnel sets, announcers, crowds, drivers and pit crews and feel the adrenaline soar! 

Key Features:

  • x9 vehicles with customizable pieces 

  • 800+ unique prefabs and blueprints

  • x12 characters, rigged and ready for animation

  • Includes generic assets folder with 350+ prefabs including buildings, props, environment, weapons, and FX

*Contents may vary between engines

📦 Pack Content

Assets include:

◼ Characters ◼ 

Announcers, Crowd, Drivers, Pit Crew

◼ Character Attachments ◼ 

Bandana, earmuffs, glasses, hair, hats, headsets, helmets, medals, snacks

◼ Props ◼ 

Air gun, balloons, background props, banana peel, barriers, billboards, bleachers, bottles, boom gate, breaker bar, bunting, cables, cameras, cans, car podiums, chairs, clapper, clothing, computer bank, cones, flags, fire extinguisher, flowers, foam fingers, food cart, food, front jack, fuel cans, fuel rig, gantries, hot air balloon, jack stand, laptop, keg, letters, numbers, lights, pit arms, pit boxes, pit wall, planters, plushies, portaloo, podium, microphones, raceboxes, racing simulator, scissor lift, screens, signs, speakers, stage pieces, symbols, tables, tents, ticket booth, traffic lights, trollies, trophies, turnstiles, tyres, umbrellas, vehicle lift, windsock

◼ Buildings ◼ 

Background buildings, awnings, docks, modular grandstand pieces including a VIP box, railing, ramps, ruins, tower, modular tunnel set, water tower

◼ Environment ◼ 

Cliffs, hills, trees, ramps, roads, road markings, sandpits, tyre marks

◼ Vehicles ◼  

Blimp, foodtrucks, dirtbike, kart, open wheeler, pace car, prototype, stock car, touring, rally, trailer, truck, vintage, various customizable pieces

◼ FX ◼ 

Bottle spray, camera flash, checkpoint, confetti, direction arrows, engine smoke, exhaust backfire, exhaust smoke, flame booster, impact sparks, sparks, skid smoke, wheel dust, crowd groups, crowd singles

products.title: INTERFACE - Fantasy Menus
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE - Fantasy Menus

Our dwarven artificers have been busily hammering away at elements such as frames, buttons, popups and icons. They have also built out a set of sprites to allow you to build your own title lockups and crests.

The Fantasy Menus pack contains dozens of pre-built menu screens and popups that can be easily customized to suit the needs of your game, and is intended to work alongside our Fantasy Warrior HUD pack. 

◼ Key Features ◼

  • Over 200 prefabs (with animations!)
  • 700+ sprites and icons
  • Customisable visual variants for components allow you to add your own style to your game’s menus. Create hundreds of variations to fit your game’s specific needs!
  • Customisable crest components and sprites for creating game title lockups and menu panel imagery.
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck.
  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of POLYGON assets.

  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised and localised. 

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with Unity’s UGUI and 2D systems. The sprites can be used in any UI program. No 3D models are included. 

◼ Complete Your Project ◼

Fantasy Menus is intended to work alongside the INTERFACE Fantasy Warrior HUD pack and our fantasy environment packs such as POLYGON Fantasy Kingdom.

◼ Interface Tutorials ◼

New to exploring UI? Head to the official Synty YouTube channel for INTERFACE tutorials.

🔍 FAQs

Q: Can I use the fonts in this pack for my game or project?
A: Yes, fonts included in this pack are Google Fonts called Grenze and Texturina. You will be able to find more information in the pack documentation, and can check out the Google Fonts FAQ here. 

Check the bottom of this page for more INTERFACE FAQs.

products.title: ANIMATION - Goblin Locomotion
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: ANIMATION - Goblin Locomotion

Welcome to Goblin Locomotion, a specialised animation pack delivering a dynamic range of movements for your goblin characters.

Watch your goblin characters leap (or stumble) into action with vibrant, expressive motions that inject energy and creativity into your gameplay, elevating both the characters and the world they inhabit.

Featuring high quality locomotion animations with each state meticulously crafted. This set comes complete with multiple animations and smooth transitions, offering a versatile collection of movement to bring your goblins to life with fluidity and personality.

Dive into the Mecanim Animation Controllers included in this pack and unlock a treasure trove of knowledge on setting up animation states, transitions, blend trees, and parameters. Whether you're a seasoned pro or an aspiring developer, our resources provide the perfect launchpad for crafting your own unique animation controller.

Don't just make characters – make them come alive with Synty's Animation - Goblin Locomotion. Transport your players into a world where every step, jump, and slide feels like magic.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 398 animation clips, including POLYGON and Sidekicks variants, as separate files allowing you to selectively import the animations you need into your project
  • Character controller example scripts
  • Mecanim animation controller
  • Demo scenes to test the animations
  • Gallery scenes with all the animations laid out
  • POLYGON and Sidekicks crash dummy characters, fully rigged and animated
  • Built for Unity, FBX files included
  • Polygon and Sidekick crash dummy model and animation controller demo scenes included!

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

🔍 FAQs

Q: Does this pack work with Unity’s Mecanim Animation System?
A: Yes! 

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty POLYGON packs?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters, all through Mecanim 

Q: Do these animations work with Synty Sidekicks characters?
A: Yes! There is a full set of Sidekick-specific versions included.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: These animations are not designed specifically to work with SIMPLE characters, but should still work when retargeted using Mecanim. 

Q: Can I use these animations on my own custom rig?
A: Only POLYGON/Sidekick rigs and retargeting using Mecanim are officially supported. 

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal Engine?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

1x POLYGON dummy and 1x Sidekicks dummy.

◼ Animations ◼

Leaning, rest, crouching, fidgeting, falling, jumping, landing, turning, sprinting, running, stumbling, standing, walking, looking, transitions.

products.title: POLYGON - Valentine's Kit | FREE
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios Presents: POLYGON - Valentine's Kit

Spread the low poly love! Our Valentine’s Day kit delivers romantic props, an adorable archer, and delectable chocolates—everything you need to create a heartwarming scene in your game or project.

Features Cupid character, bow and arrow, flowers, balloons, chocolates, a teddy bear and more!

📦 Pack Content

◼ Characters ◼ 
Cupid with Wings

◼ Props ◼ 
Heart Chocolate Box, Chocolates, Roses, Teddy, Bow, Arrow, Valentines Letter.

🤖 Technical Info

◼ Compatibility ◼

  • Compatible with Unreal 5.3+
  • Compatible with Unity 2022.3+
    - Supports URP and Built-in
    - Characters set up with Mecanim (no animations included)

◼ File Formats ◼

  • Unreal 5.3 project
  • Unity 2022.3 package
  • FBX Source Files
📋 Changelog

products.title: INTERFACE - Military Combat HUD
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE - Military Combat HUD

War never changes, but sometimes it needs a cheeky visual upgrade. Synty’s Interface Military Combat HUD pack features a library of combat-focused military components to help you dominate the UI battlefield.

Alongside action bars, compasses, mini-maps and weapon wheels, there are competitive shooter components including revive timers, fireteam info, ‘Killed By’ panes and Match Start / Match Complete animations. We’ve also included a customisable badge system for building team badges, rank up / level up badges, and reward and kill streak badges.

Each component is designed for maximum flexibility, whether you’re making a Looter Shooter, Battle Royale, team-based extraction, or a military FPS. 

◼ Key Features ◼

  • Over 200 prefabs/blueprints (with animations!)
  • 1,500+ sprites and icons
  • Customisable visual variants for components allow you to add your own style to your game’s HUD. Create hundreds of variations to fit your game’s specific needs!
  • Customisable badge components and sprites for rank/level up, team select, rewards and more.
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck.
  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of POLYGON assets.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised and localised. 
◼ Complete Your Project ◼

Check out POLYGON - Military Pack and POLYGON - Battle Royale Pack, both will work very well with Military Combat HUD.

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with 2D systems. The sprites can be used in any UI program. No 3D models are included. 

🔍 FAQs

Q: Can I use the fonts in this pack for my game or project?
A: Yes, fonts included in this pack are Google Fonts called Oxanium You can find more information in the pack documentation or can check out the Google Fonts FAQ here.

Check the bottom of this page for more INTERFACE FAQs.

products.title: ANIMATION - Idles
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: ANIMATION – Idles

Welcome to Idles, a specialised animation pack designed to give your characters quirky behavioural traits to bring life to your environment and depth to your worlds. Perfect for that village full of quest-givers, or to have your hero wait with flair.

Featuring meticulously crafted idle animations, this pack will accelerate your workflow by providing a cohesive collection of motions to elevate humanoid character performances.

Your characters may be idle, but they don't need to be boring!

◼ Key Features ◼

Animation Sets
330 Idle animation FBX files, including RootMotion versions, designed for a complete combat system with smooth blending and transitions. Includes both masculine and feminine. Each animation is a separate file, allowing you to import only the animations you need into your project. 

Works with Synty's ANIMATION - Base Locomotion and Unity's Mecanim 
This pack includes documentation to guide you on how to blend Idles with Synty’s Base Locomotion animations.

Gallery Scene
We’ve included a scene featuring all the animations as a separate asset, so you can easily view each individual animation.

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

🔍 FAQs

Q: Does this pack work with Unity’s Mecanim Animation System?
A: Yes! 

Q: Can I use this pack with Synty’s ANIMATION - Base Locomotion?
A: Yes, documentation is provided to guide you in blending ANIMATION - Idles with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion. There's an example animation controller included in the Base Locomotion pack, as well as transition animations for integration with Base Locomotion.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty POLYGON packs?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters. 

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: These animations are not designed specifically to work with SIMPLE characters, but should still work when retargeted using Mecanim. 

Q: Can I use these animations on my own custom rig?
A: Only POLYGON rigs and retargeting using Mecanim are officially supported. 

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal Engine?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no official Synty support is currently offered for this.

products.title: POLYGON - Goblin War Camp
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Goblin War Camp

In a festering swamp, surrounded by makeshift walls reinforced with wood, hide, bone and scraps, lies the Goblin War Camp. You trudge through the stronghold amid their preparations for war, but beware, goblins don’t care for outsiders...

Fires burn in pits, casting flickering shadows, while the fierce horde ready their weapons ahead of the next battle. Structures are haphazardly arranged, some elevated on stilts above the festering swamp. The air is heavy with the smell of damp earth, smoke, and sweat.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 600+ premium prefabs / blueprints
  • Unique complete buildings / structures
  • 15 characters, rigged and ready for animation
  • Includes a swampy goblin stronghold demo scene

*Contents may vary between engines.

products.title: INTERFACE - Fantasy Warrior HUD
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: INTERFACE – Fantasy Warrior HUD

Hey, listen! Take up your sword and shield, pack fifteen wheels of cheese into your pouch and prepare to battle the evil forces of scaling your UI across multiple resolutions and device screen sizes!

We've packed in a wide range of HUD components, including hearts bars, compasses and minimaps, companion portraits, dialogue selection, weapon wheels, action bars, magic and healing effects. Each component is designed for maximum customization, whether you’re building an action RPG, a sprawling fantasy open world, or a souls-like survival adventure. 

Designed to work alongside INTERFACE - Fantasy Menus. 

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 178 prefabs (with animations) / 279 blueprints
  • 1,100+ sprites and icons
  • Customisable visual variants for components allows you to add your own style to your game's HUD. Create hundreds of variations to fit your game's specific needs!
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types including PC, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and Steam Deck. 
  • Blends seamlessly with Synty’s expansive library of POLYGON assets.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, customised, and localised.
  • Unreal Engine support for this pack was added in August 2025!

*The UI components in this pack are 2D and designed to work with Unity’s UGUI / Unreal's UMG, and 2D systems. The sprites/textures can be used in any UI program. No 3D models are included. 

◼ Complete Your World ◼

Icons featuring props and weapons in this HUD pack are rendered from items and weapons found in POLYGON Fantasy Kingdom, the perfect match to Fantasy Warrior HUD. 

◼ Learn More ◼

Check out our HUD related video tutorials:

  • Creating a HUD in Unity
  • Creating a Minimap in Unity

🔍 FAQs

A: Yes, fonts included in this pack are Google Fonts called Grenze and Texturina. You will be able to find more information in the pack documentation, and can check out the Google Fonts FAQ here.

products.title: ANIMATION - Sword Combat
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents:  ANIMATION - Sword Combat

A specialised Synty ANIMATION pack!

This pack features meticulously hand-crafted animations that will accelerate your workflow by providing a cohesive collection of motions, designed to integrate easily with other Synty ANIMATION packages.

Complete with 105 Sword Combat essential animations – including light and heavy attacks, fabulous flourishes, dramatic deaths, lively leaps and more. Each with multiple animations and smooth transitions so your characters will move with ease. 

Witness your characters come to life with immersive fluidity as you unleash the power of sword combat into your creations!

◼ Key Features ◼

Animation Sets
105 Sword Combat animation FBX files, including RootMotion versions, designed for a complete combat system with smooth blending and transitions. Each animation is a separate file, allowing you to import only the animations you need into your project. 

Gallery Scene
We’ve included a scene featuring all the animations as a separate asset, so you can easily view each individual animation.

Works with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion
This pack includes documentation to guide you on how to blend Sword Combat with Synty’s Base Locomotion animations.

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

*Contents may vary between engines. 

🔍 FAQs

Q: Does this pack work with Mecanim?
A: Yes! However, this pack only supports standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters. ANIMATION - Swords Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other characters. 

Q: Can I use this pack with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion?
A: Yes, documentation is provided to guide you in blending ANIMATION - Sword Combat with ANIMATION - Base Locomotion. There's an example animation controller included in the pack, as well as transition animations for integration with Base Locomotion.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty POLYGON packs?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with standard POLYGON characters, POLYGON Kids, and POLYGON Big Rig characters. 

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty SIMPLE packs?
A: No, these animations do not work with SIMPLE characters. 

Q: Can I use the animations on my own custom rig?
A: ANIMATION - Swords Combat animations make use of a prop bone, an extra bone added to the hand. You may need to retarget the animations using third-party tools to get the prop bone to animate correctly on other character rigs even when using mecanim. 

Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: This pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is currently no timeline for Unreal Engine support for Synty ANIMATION products.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported, you can import the animation FBX files into Unreal Engine, retarget them using the Unreal animations tool, and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no Synty support is currently offered for this.

products.title: POLYGON - Pride Crystal Weapons | FREE
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Pride Crystal Weapons

As voted by our community, Crystal Weapons are the custom asset created for global Pride Month 2024. Synty 3D artist, Branch, once again took on the challenge, and they really delivered! Here's what they had to say about the design approach:

“When we were brainstorming how to incorporate the Pride part of the set, we came up with the idea to use the Pride flag colours as the alts. It took some trial and error, some of the flags were more difficult than others. Just taking the flags and making them a gradient made for some rather messy colours. So instead, I used some of the specific colour strips in the flags as handle or highlight colours. It was really fun to work on these, and to have the opportunity to work on some different texturing methods!” – Branch, 3D Artist

We hope these weapons add some sparkle and style to your projects!

products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents: POLYGON - Apocalypse Wasteland

Over 100 years after an environmental disaster devastates Earth, two factions – the Desert Anarchists and the Goop Mutants – are at war for the resources to survive across two unique biomes.

Apocalypse Wasteland delivers an expansive stylized asset pack filled with buildings, characters, props, modular weapons, vehicles, FX, and environment assets to create your post-apocalyptic or dystopian game world. 

Do you dare to wander the roads of the vast wasteland demo scene and embrace the chaos it conceals? 

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 1,600+ premium prefabs
  • Fully modular wasteland weaponry
  • 23 unique vehicles
  • 23 characters, rigged and ready for animation
  • Vast wasteland demo scene with 2 contrasting biomes
  • A concerning amount of Goop

Looking to expand your wasteland world further?

products.title: INTERFACE - Sci-Fi Soldier HUD
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios Presents: INTERFACE - Sci-Fi Soldier HUD

After popular demand, INTERFACE HUD packs make a return! So strap on your tactical helmet, grab your wildly inaccurate laser blaster and prepare for the future of combat technology with the INTERFACE - Sci-Fi Soldier HUD.

Futuristic weapon crosshairs, shield and impact effects, action bars, compasses and minimaps, weapon wheels and HP bars - we’ve included an extensive library of components to streamline the creation of your game HUD. Every component has been built to be as customisable as possible, whether your game is a sci-fi shooter, a survival game on a harsh alien world or an action-packed future RPG.

Quickly build out your game HUD with dozens of pre-built HUD elements assembled from the latest technology. Action bars, minimaps, compasses, weapon wheels, HP bars, damage FX, crosshairs - we’ve added everything we could think of to help you quickly assemble a quality-looking, responsive HUD. Each component can be visually customized to suit your game’s needs, whether you’re making an ultra-minimal futuristic shooter game or an incredibly advanced space ARPG.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • Over 1000 sprites and icons assembled into over 150 prefabs (with animations!). Easily piece together a unique UI with customisable components.
  • Seamlessly blend your game's UI with gameplay by using the 600+ icons included. Icons of props and weapons are rendered from items and weapons found in: POLYGON - Sci-Fi Space, POLYGON - Sci-Fi Worlds, POLYGON - Sci-Fi Cyber City and POLYGON - Sci-fi City
  • Customisable visual variants for components allows your to add your own style to your game's HUD. You can create hundreds of variations to fit your specific game's needs.
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types easily lets you support PC, Xbox, PS, and Switch!
  • Artistically blends with existing Synty asset packs. We've designed the UI to match Synty's POLYGON style. Your game will look sleek and professionally made with a UI that matches your games 3D aesthetic.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, localised and customised

*The UI elements contained in this pack are 2D and intended to work with 2D systems. No 3D models are included.

◼ Tutorials ◼
View our UI tutorials 
- Creating a HUD in Unity
- Creating a Minimap in Unity

products.title: ANIMATION - Base Locomotion
products.body_html:
Synty® Studios presents:  ANIMATION - Base Locomotion

Elevate your game to new heights with the dynamic motion of Synty's Animation - Base Locomotion. Bring your characters life with fluid movement and seamless transitions. Say goodbye to the hassle of sourcing animations from all over the internet and constructing your controller from scratch – our comprehensive pack equips you with everything you need to bring your characters to life in no time.

This powerhouse pack is brimming with essential animations for every common character motion need – from leisurely walks to adrenaline-pumping sprints, graceful jumps to heart-racing slides. With each state meticulously crafted, complete with multiple animations and smooth transitions, your characters will move with unparalleled grace.

But wait, there's more! We've gone the extra mile by providing animations for both masculine and feminine figures, ensuring that your game's characters exude authenticity and diversity. With the ability to seamlessly blend between the two, the possibilities for character expression and personality are limitless.

Dive deep into the Mecanim Animation Controllers included in this pack and unlock a treasure trove of knowledge on setting up animation states, transitions, blend trees, and parameters. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a budding developer, these resources provide the perfect launchpad for crafting your own unique animation controller.

Don't just make games – make them come alive with Synty's Animation - Base Locomotion. Your players won't just play; they'll be transported into a world where every step, jump, and slide feels like magic.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • 247 Animation clips as separate files allow you to to only import the animations you need into your project
  • Character controller example scripts
  • Mecanim animation controllers - Masculine and Feminine
  • Demo scene to test the animations
  • Gallery scene with all the animations laid out
  • Crash dummy character - fully rigged and animated

ANIMATION Collection Bundle
Grab this pack as part of the ANIMATION Collection bundle containing all 6 of Synty's high quality ANIMATION packs at 50% off.

🔍 FAQs

◼ Unity ◼
Q: Does the pack work with Mecanim?
A: Yes! This pack is designed to work with the Mecanim humanoid avatar.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty POLYGON packs?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with POLYGON characters, and any  characters that work with the Mecanim humanoid avatar.

Q: Do these animations work with characters in Synty Simple packs?
A: Yes! These animations are designed to work with Simple characters, and any  characters that work with the Mecanim humanoid avatar.

Q: Can I use the animations in this pack for my commercial game or project?
A: Yes, all Synty assets on Synty Store allow you to use them for commercial purposes royalty free (some exclusions apply, Please read our EULA)

◼ Unreal ◼
Q: Does this pack support Unreal Engine?
A: Currently this pack does not officially support Unreal Engine. There is no timeline for Unreal Engine support, but we will support Unreal Engine in the future.

Q: Can the animations be used in Unreal?
A: Even though Unreal Engine is not officially supported you can import the animation FBX files (included as a zip) into Unreal Engine retarget them using the Unreal animations tool and use them on the Unreal Mannequin. However no support is currently offered for this.

◼ Other ◼
Q: Does the animations work outside of Unity?
A: The animations in this pack are designed to work inside Unity. Use of the animations outside of Unity is untested and not supported at this stage.

products.body_html:
Synty® Studios Presents: INTERFACE - Apocalypse HUD

From the ashes of a global catastrophe rises the INTERFACE Apocalypse HUD, the first in Synty’s new line of UI packs!

Quickly build out your game HUD with dozens of pre-built HUD elements cobbled together from rusted metal and salvaged electronic components. Action bars, minimaps, compasses, weapon wheels, HP bars, damage FX, crosshairs - we’ve added everything we could think of to help you quickly assemble a quality-looking, responsive HUD. Each component can be visually customized to suit your game’s needs, whether you’re making an ultra-minimal survival game or an apocalyptic ARPG.

◼ Key Features ◼

  • Over 160 prefabs (with animations!). Easily piece together a unique UI with customisable components.
  • Seamlessly blend your game's UI with gameplay by using the 650+ icons included. Icons of props and weapons are rendered from items and weapons found in the POLYGON - Apocalypse Pack.
  • Customisable visual variants for components allows your to add your own style to your game's HUD. You can create hundreds of variations to fit your specific game's needs.
  • Comprehensive range of input icons for multiple controller types easily lets you support PC, Xbox, PS, and Switch!
  • Artistically blends with existing Synty asset packs. We've designed the UI to match Synty's POLYGON style. Your game will look sleek and professionally made with a UI that matches your games 3D aesthetic.
  • Text and numeric buttons can be tinted, localised and customised

*The UI elements contained in this pack are 2D and intended to work with Unity's UGUI and 2D systems.  No 3D models are included.

View our first UI tutorial - 'Creating a HUD in Unity' - on YouTube!
